title: 06.01 - Report abuse in a survey
intent: Explain how participants can report a survey that contains illegal content or violates rights.
short_answer: If a survey contains illegal content or violates the rights of others, use the Report Abuse link on the right-side panel of the survey.
procedure: Refer to the EUSurvey Terms of Service for more information: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/home/tos.
important_conditions: This applies to illegal content or content that violates rights, including intellectual property rights, competition law, or general law.
Use the survey owner contact option for ordinary survey-specific questions.
related_articles: 02.01 - How to contact the survey owner

synonyms: How do I report abuse in a survey?
